## Rome Solo Adventure: 5-Day Historical & Culinary Journey

This itinerary is designed for a solo traveler visiting Rome from October 10-14, 2024, with a daily budget of €100 for food and activities, focusing on historical sites and local cuisine.

### Daily Itinerary & Budget Guide

**Day 1: Ancient Rome & Trastevere Charm**
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Colosseum_in_Rome,_Italy_-_April_2007.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
-   Morning: Immerse yourself in the **Colosseum**, **Roman Forum**, and **Palatine Hill**. Consider a combined ticket for efficiency.
-   Afternoon: Explore the picturesque streets of **Trastevere**, visiting the Basilica di Santa Maria in Trastevere.
-   Food: Enjoy an authentic Roman dinner in Trastevere, savoring dishes like cacio e pepe or supplì.
Action: [Button: Book Colosseum Tickets] https://www.coopculture.it/en/tickets/

**Day 2: Vatican City & Papal Splendor**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
-   Morning: Discover the artistic treasures of the **Vatican Museums**, the awe-inspiring **Sistine Chapel**, and the grandeur of **St. Peter's Basilica**.
-   Afternoon: Wander through **St. Peter's Square** and cross **Ponte Sant'Angelo** to visit **Castel Sant'Angelo**.
-   Food: Grab a quick pizza al taglio for lunch, followed by a traditional pasta dinner near the Vatican area.
Action: [Button: Book Vatican Tickets] https://www.museivaticani.va/content/museivaticani/en.html

**Day 3: Baroque Fountains & Pantheon Majesty**
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Fontana_di_Trevi.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
-   Morning: Toss a coin in the iconic **Trevi Fountain**, ascend the **Spanish Steps**, and marvel at the architectural wonder of the **Pantheon**.
-   Afternoon: Soak in the artistic ambiance of **Piazza Navona** and experience the vibrant market at **Campo de' Fiori**.
-   Food: Indulge in authentic Italian gelato, enjoy a classic espresso, and dine at a charming trattoria in the city center.

**Day 4: Art, Gardens & Roman Views**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
-   Morning: Immerse yourself in masterpieces at the **Borghese Gallery** (advance booking is highly recommended).
-   Afternoon: Relax and stroll through the beautiful **Villa Borghese gardens**, culminating with sunset views from **Pincio Terrace**.
-   Food: Sample local delicacies at **Testaccio Market** for lunch, followed by dinner in the bohemian Monti neighborhood.
Action: [Button: Book Borghese Tickets] https://galleriaborghese.beniculturali.it/en/

**Day 5: Ancient Catacombs & Departure**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
-   Morning: Journey along the historic **Appian Way** (Via Appia Antica) and explore the ancient **Catacombs of Callixtus** or Domitilla.
-   Afternoon: Enjoy a final Roman coffee and pick up any last-minute souvenirs before heading to the airport for departure.
-   Food: Savor a traditional Roman breakfast, followed by a light lunch before your onward journey.

**Budget Considerations**
-   The €100 daily budget is allocated for entrance fees, public transport, and all meals.
-   Typical entrance fees for major sites range from €10 to €25.
-   Public transport (bus/metro) is affordable, with single tickets around €1.50 or a 24-hour pass for €7.
-   Food estimates: Breakfast €5-10, Lunch €15-25 (e.g., pizza al taglio, panino), Dinner €30-50 (trattoria meal).
-   This budget allows for a rich experience of Rome's history and cuisine, with flexibility for some additional treats.
